docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The sākhīs, padas and ramainīs of the weaver-saint Kabīr, in the edition of Shyamsundar Das (1928) with his long introduction on the poet.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Kabīr (fifteenth century), Kabīr Granthāvalī, edited by Shyamsundar Das (1875–1945), Nagari Pracharini Sabha, 1928, as transcribed on Hindi Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
